threat_event: Business email compromise: an attacker who controls a mailbox sends changed wire instructions and the credit union sends a member's funds to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written callback procedure; wire requests accepted by email; shared Member Services mailbox signed in with a password only until 2026-08-12; no BEC training
existing_controls: Maker-checker dual control with hardware tokens; fidelity bond; cyber policy with a $100,000 social engineering sublimit
treatment_plan: Written wire security procedure: callback to the phone number on file for every wire request not made in person, recorded in the wire file (POL-02 B.10); no wire instructions accepted by email alone; BEC training and quarterly phishing exercises; shared mailbox converted to delegated access with MFA (done 2026-08-12)

threat_event: Theft of member NPI (loan documents with Social Security numbers, ID copies) from the shared Member Services mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3 years of member documents kept in one mailbox; password-only sign-in until 2026-08-12; password unchanged after an MSR left; no alerts on forwarding rules or unusual sign-ins
regulatory_driver: N52-R01 (748 App. A II.B; III.C.1.a); N52-R01 (748 App. B III.A); Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: MFA on named accounts
treatment_plan: Delegated shared mailbox with MFA (done 2026-08-12); move member documents to the imaging server and delete them from email after 30 days; suite alerts for forwarding rules and risky sign-ins; secure upload link for members instead of email

threat_event: Takeover of a member's online banking account and theft of funds through transfers or bill pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Member MFA only at new-device registration by text code; no alerts on contact data or payee changes; changes to member phone numbers not verified (2025 takeover after a phone number change)
existing_controls: Provider fraud scoring; staff admin console MFA
treatment_plan: Turn on member MFA at every sign-in from a new device and for payee and contact changes; member alerts for contact, payee, and large transfer events; verify phone number changes by callback; update the Identity Theft Prevention Program

threat_event: Former employee uses a still-active account or known shared password to reach member information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist or access review; former MSR's core account enabled 5 months after departure; shared mailbox password unchanged
existing_controls: Core reachable only from the office IP address
treatment_plan: Termination checklist completed on the last day (POL-02 B.4); monthly user reconciliation in the core, admin console, wire portal, LOS, and suite (POL-02 B.5); account disabled 2026-08-05

threat_event: Ransomware from a phishing email encrypts office computers and reaches the imaging server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; antivirus alerts only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; imaging server reachable from every office computer
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring; training (R-001); immutable copy of imaging backups (R-010)

threat_event: Security incident at the core processor exposes member data or stops service, and the credit union learns of it late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core contract predates the NCUA cyber incident rule and sets no incident notice time frame; SOC reports not reviewed before 2026-08-18
existing_controls: SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports received yearly
treatment_plan: Side letter now and contract terms at renewal: incident notice to the credit union as soon as possible and within 24 hours of detection, with the facts needed for the 748.1(c) report and member notice; annual SOC review (P09)

threat_event: Credit union misses the 72-hour NCUA cyber incident report or the Appendix B member notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 incident plan predates 748.1(c) (effective 2023-09-01); no criteria for when an incident is reportable; no member notice template
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R03 (748.1(c)); N52-R01 (748 App. B II.A.1.b; III)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook add the reportable-incident test, the 72-hour clock, the NCUA contact, and member notice templates; tabletop exercise

threat_event: A vendor control failure goes unnoticed because SOC reports are not reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC reports filed unread; complementary user entity controls not mapped; no bridge letters
existing_controls: SOC reports collected yearly
treatment_plan: Annual SOC review with CUEC mapping for each critical vendor (core done 2026-08-18; digital banking provider by 2026-11-30); bridge letters

threat_event: An employee misuses member information or embezzles funds through the core
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of core user activity or exception reports; all MSRs hold the supervisor override profile
existing_controls: Background checks; dual control on wires; fidelity bond; supervisory committee audit
treatment_plan: Monthly review of core override, dormant-account, and employee-account reports by the Accounting and Compliance Officer; remove supervisor override from 2 of 3 MSRs

threat_event: Imaging server and its snapshots are deleted or encrypted, and signature cards and ID copies are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Snapshots in the same cloud account; MSP console login without MFA and shared by two technicians; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily snapshots kept 14 days; disk encryption
treatment_plan: Named MSP logins with MFA; copy of backups to a separate account with immutable retention; restore test by 2026-09-30 and quarterly after

threat_event: AI credit scoring produces unlawful adverse action reasons or discriminatory outcomes
threat_source: AI model error or bias (vendor model)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without validation, fair lending review, or a check of reason codes; auto-approval above the cutoff; 9 of 45 decline notices gave only a score-based reason
regulatory_driver: N52-R01 (748 App. A III.D); ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.9(b)(2); 1002.6); FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681m(a)
existing_controls: Lending Manager decides every decline
treatment_plan: Conditions in P10: corrected notices, reason-code mapping, second review of declines, fairness testing, vendor documentation and data-use terms

threat_event: Theft or compromise of an unencrypted desktop exposes the nightly balance file and cached member scans
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 8 desktops unencrypted; the offline-teller balance file lists every member's name, address, and balances
existing_controls: Office alarm; vault; locked after hours
treatment_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on all 8 desktops; scans saved to the imaging server, not the desktop

threat_event: Internet outage stops teller access, phones, and wire callbacks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line for data and VoIP phones; no failover
existing_controls: Offline teller mode; staff cell phones
treatment_plan: Cellular failover router; forward the main number to a staff cell phone during outages

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool or cloud login reaches every computer and the imaging server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access everywhere; no evidence of MFA or technician list; cloud tenant held in the MSP's name
existing_controls: MSP contract with confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (MFA evidence, technician list, subcontractors); 24-hour incident notice and a recovery time commitment in the contract; tenant moved into the credit union's name

threat_event: Core processor outage longer than one business day stops vital member services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core RTO (8 h) longer than the BIA RTO (4 h); offline teller mode limited to $500 withdrawals; business continuity plan never tested
existing_controls: Offline teller mode; vendor second data center
treatment_plan: Rewrite the business continuity plan from the BIA; annual participation in the core processor's disaster recovery test; confirm the 749.2(b) language in the core contract

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; no alternate site; continuity plan untested
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted core and online banking reachable from anywhere; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist: laptops home before landfall, shared-branching or partner credit union arrangement for cash access, catastrophic act report within 5 business days (748.1(b)), member notice script

threat_event: NCUA supervisory action because the risk assessment and program are out of date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 risk assessment; no board report since 2022; annual 748.1(a) certification filed without a current program; 2025 examination recommendation open
regulatory_driver: N52-R01 (748 App. A III.A; III.B; III.F); N52-R01 (748.1(a))
existing_controls: 2026 risk assessment (this register)
treatment_plan: Annual risk assessment each July; annual board report each August (first on 2026-08-25); certification based on the current program

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident or a suspicious request in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security video at hire only; no reporting rule; no phishing exercises
existing_controls: Annual BSA training
treatment_plan: Annual security training; reporting rule on a card at each workstation (POL-03 4.2); quarterly phishing exercises

threat_event: Email with member documents sent to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Member documents emailed without message encryption; no address check
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Secure upload link and encrypted email for member documents; double-check rule in training

threat_event: Unpatched firewall firmware exploited for access to the office network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware patched by the MSP but no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: MSP patching; no management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly external vulnerability scan by the MSP; report to the ISO

threat_event: Member information recovered from a retired computer or drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 desktops retired in 2024 with no wipe or destruction record
existing_controls: Paper shredding with certificates
treatment_plan: Certified wipe or destruction with serial-number certificates for every retired device; ask the MSP what happened to the 2024 desktops

threat_event: Card data compromise at the card processor or the lobby ATM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card data handled by the card processor and ATM vendor; SOC report not reviewed
existing_controls: Card processor fraud monitoring; card network rules; card reissue process
treatment_plan: Accepted: card processor and network rules carry most of the loss and response; residual risk Low; SOC review added to the annual cycle

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes member information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave the office with the CEO, Operations Manager, and Lending Manager
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; MSP can wipe remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted: laptops encrypted; encrypted data is outside Fla. Stat. 501.171's definition of personal information; residual risk Low
